old: Bound-text containers currently grow the container when text overflows.
new: Bound-text containers must optionally use a fitting behavior that shrinks text to fit within a fixed container size, controlled by an "auto text size" toggle and a fontSizeMax ceiling, instead of growing the container.
evidence_quote: expose the same fitting behaviour to ordinary bound-text containers, opt-in per element rather than as a new default. The "auto text size" toggle in the text settings proposed above would be a natural switch, with `fontSizeMax` as the value it captures.
